_comment_build: Portable build workflow. All tool paths are OPTIONAL: leave them out to auto-discover via PATH / sibling of arm-none-eabi-gcc / common install dirs. On a new machine, prefer EMBEDDED_* env vars over hardcoding paths here.
_comment_toolchain_example: Uncomment only if auto-discovery fails (e.g. toolchain installed in a nonstandard location). Keys: cmake, ninja, arm_gcc, arm_gdb, arm_size, arm_objcopy, jlink_gdbserver.
_comment_env: EMBEDDED_* env vars (set in the MCP client config) override discovery without editing this file: EMBEDDED_CMAKE, EMBEDDED_NINJA, EMBEDDED_ARM_GCC, EMBEDDED_ARM_GDB, EMBEDDED_ARM_SIZE, EMBEDDED_ARM_OBJCOPY, EMBEDDED_JLINK_GDBSERVER. Avoid names containing KEY/PASSWORD/SECRET/TOKEN and DSH_* (scrubbed by the MCP client bridge).
